entities.name: EPS bearer context status
entities.description: Indicates the EPS bearer contexts that are active for the UE in the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that includes the EPS bearer context status IE to indicate active EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: Active EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: The set of EPS bearer contexts that are currently active for the UE.

relations.description: The network includes the EPS bearer context status IE in messages when it wants to indicate active EPS bearer contexts.
The EPS bearer context status IE indicates which EPS bearer contexts are active for the UE.
